approaches.title: Stack-based score aggregation
approaches.summary: Uses a stack of partial scores, combining nested groups when closing parentheses and treating () as score 1.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Implements the parentheses scoring algorithm with a stack of partial scores.

approaches.title: Depth-weighted counting
approaches.summary: Computes the score by tracking nesting depth and adding a power of two for each primitive (). This avoids the explicit score stack.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replaces the stack with depth counting and adds 2^depth for each primitive pair.
Simplifies the power-of-two calculation from exponentiation to a bit shift while preserving the depth-counting strategy.
